name: Girls' Day Out
source:
A story about three women out shopping, but one of them, Ophelia, isn't doing so great...
Thankfully, her two best friends Arshila and Ralynint are here to help, and they've always got her back!

[From [url=https://rozenymph.itch.io/girls-day-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于三个女人外出购物的故事，但其中一位，奥菲莉亚，过得并不好……
值得庆幸的是，她的两个最好的朋友Arshila和Ralynint随时为她提供帮助，而且他们总是让她回来！

[来自[url=https://rozenymph.itch.io/girls-day-out]Itch.io[/url]]
